description: This file defines the core components related to TensorFlow operations within the Go client language, including the Operation and Output types, methods to access operation properties, and the management of tensor outputs and their consumers.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an operation added to a TensorFlow computational graph, providing methods to query its properties such as name, type, outputs, device, and consumers.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Represents an output (tensor) from an operation, including its data type, shape, and methods to retrieve consumer information.

classes.name: Consumer
classes.description: Identifies a specific input of an operation that consumes a particular output.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the TensorFlow operation.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type or operator name of the operation.

methods.name: NumOutputs
methods.description: Returns the number of outputs produced by the operation.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Returns the device specification where the operation will be or was executed.

methods.name: OutputListSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the list of outputs for a specific named output of the operation.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Returns a specific output of the operation by index.

methods.name: NumInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs to the operation.

methods.name: DataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensor produced by the output.

methods.name: Shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor produced by the output.

methods.name: Consumers
methods.description: Returns the list of consumers that use this output as input.

methods.name: Producer
methods.description: Returns the output that feeds into a specific consumer.
